changed_factor_vs_source_only: addTemplate feature-selection mask becomes empty cv::Mat(); binary source clone and official silhouette mask/pose geometry unchanged
training_source: clone of unchanged binary 0/255 official warped mask
feature_selection_mask: empty cv::Mat() at addTemplate; no custom dilation/morphology/threshold tuning
actual_features: record actual counts and failures under unchanged V11 exhaustive selector; never fabricate or omit attempts
warp_policy: unchanged mask ROI/canvas/affine, nearest-neighbor official mask, black border
feature_border_distance: record every successful layer minimum distance of absolute feature coordinates to actual layer canvas edge; diagnostics only, no feature filtering or border selection
bbox_conversion: match minus fixed left/top padding plus official warped mask bbox origin minus this new template's actual tl_x/tl_y; retain official width/height
cross_arm_identity: GT IDs and object/training_image/angle/scale pose keys, never coincident numerical template IDs
zero_success_or_exception: preserve every possible fixed training attempt; any zero-success object or extraction exception marks comparison incomplete and forbids image quality stages
source_only_training_comparison: training feasibility and feature diagnostics only; absent source-only banks never become valid negative-image detectors
quality_arms_if_feasible: new binary source with empty feature-selection mask bank
causal_limit_vs_rgb: source and selection-mask policy both differ from RGB; a quality change is not attributed to mask policy alone

shared_padding.union: all loaded layers in both arms and all six objects, no template filtering
shared_padding.coarse_l1: twice max(declared extent, actual maximum feature coordinate plus one)
shared_padding.freeze: all bank/metadata/attempt/source/build hashes and complete loaded geometry CSV before first development image decode

timing_schedule: fixed 64-frame flags from the frozen frame schedule, eight per scene
same_arm_equality: complete ordered candidate fields and float32 score bits
implementation_scope: new sibling directory only; private V11/core/MIPP/helper snapshots and sources/builds/input/runtime gates separate from source-only evidence
transitive_pin_policy: Before implementation/runtime expand the fixed source-only closure to all original RGB/source-only attempts, banks/config/metadata/pilot references and input expected member hashes; verify source-only frozen files unchanged. New bank and common-padding hashes are bound in later immutable freeze records before image quality stages.
